edible_resource_recognition.ability_reason: Knowing which roots, seeds and greens are safe in each season widens the gathering round and ends most poisonings of the young.

ember_tending.ability_reason: A banked fire means cooked food every day, not only when lightning or luck provides a flame.

hearth_heat_retention.ability_reason: Hot stones and banked ash keep food warm and soft for the old and the very young.

food_pounding_mortars.ability_reason: Pounded mash is the first food a weaning child can swallow safely.

nut_kernel_shelling.ability_reason: Shelled nuts turn an autumn glut into rich food that keeps.

food_drying.ability_reason: Dried fish, meat and fruit carry the band through the lean months.

seed_selection.ability_reason: Seed from the best plants gives a better harvest every year it is kept up.

friction_fire_ignition.ability_reason: Fire can be made again wherever dry wood is found, so no camp goes without cooked food.

hearth_roasting_control.ability_reason: Meat and roots roasted through on coals sicken fewer children than half-raw food.

percussion_fire_ignition.ability_reason: Struck sparks light tinder in wet weather and on the march.

smoking.ability_reason: Smoke-cured meat and fish keep for months and travel well.

root_grating_dewatering.ability_reason: Grated and squeezed roots lose their bitterness and become a staple rather than a risk.

fruit_pulp_screening.ability_reason: Clean pulp dries into cakes that keep, instead of rotting around the stones.

animal_taming.ability_reason: A penned herd is meat on the hoof: food that does not have to be hunted.
animal_taming.social_consequence: Families that keep animals gain a store of wealth that can be counted, lent and lost.

acorn_leaching.ability_reason: Leached acorn meal turns the oak woods into a store that lasts the winter.

pulse_splitting.ability_reason: Split lentils and peas cook soft enough for weaning bowls and keep dry in store.

earth_oven_cooking.ability_reason: Slow pit cooking makes tough roots and old meat worth eating, so less of the catch is wasted.

fish_weirs_and_traps.name: Fish Weirs and Traps
fish_weirs_and_traps.observation: Stakes and wicker across the shallows hold the run, and baited baskets fill while the hands that set them do other work.
fish_weirs_and_traps.social_consequence: Good fishing places become family property, passed down with the knowledge of when the fish come.

milking.name: Milking the Herd
milking.observation: Ewes and nannies that stand for the hand give milk all season, so the herd feeds people without being slaughtered.
milking.social_consequence: Herders who milk stay near their animals every day; the herd becomes the household's living larder.

indirect_solar_food_drying.ability_reason: Shaded racks dry food without scorching it, so more of the summer surplus is put by.

crop_calendars.ability_reason: Sowing and reaping at the right moon loses fewer seedlings to frost and fewer ears to rain.

threshing_frames.ability_reason: Grain beaten out on a hard floor is cleaner, quicker to store and less prone to rot.

winnowing_practice.ability_reason: Chaff-free grain keeps longer in the pit and the pot.

saddle_quern_grinding.name: Saddle Quern Grinding
saddle_quern_grinding.observation: Grain rubbed between a long stone and a hand stone becomes meal for porridge and bread, at the cost of hours on bent knees each day.
saddle_quern_grinding.social_consequence: Grinding becomes the daily work of women and girls; their knees and backs show it for life.

cereal_dehulling.ability_reason: Hulled grain cooks faster and feeds better.

hand_dough_forming.ability_reason: Kneaded dough bakes into bread that can be carried to the field.

food_steaming_vessels.ability_reason: Steamed food is soft and clean enough for infants, the sick and the toothless old.

controlled_baking.ability_reason: Flatbread baked hard keeps for days and feeds workers far from the hearth.

seed_cleaning.ability_reason: Seed sorted from weed seed and chaff comes up evenly and chokes less.

drive_hunts.name: Drive Hunts
drive_hunts.observation: Lines of beaters, brush fences and dug pits funnel a whole herd to waiting spears, and a single day's kill is dried for a season.
drive_hunts.social_consequence: The drive needs every able hand and one leader; the share of the kill becomes a matter of rank.

seed_reserves.ability_reason: Seed kept apart from eating grain means a failed year does not also take next year's sowing.

hermetic_grain_storage.ability_reason: Grain sealed in pots and plastered pits stays dry and out of reach of mice through the lean months.

wild_honey_smoking.name: Smoking Out Wild Honey
wild_honey_smoking.observation: A smouldering bundle held under a hollow tree quiets the bees long enough to cut out comb and honey.

grain_malting.ability_reason: Sprouted, dried grain is sweeter, softer and the start of beer.

starch_washing_separation.ability_reason: Washed starch makes food of roots too coarse to eat whole.

resin_sealed_wine.name: Resin-Sealed Wine
resin_sealed_wine.observation: Crushed grapes left in jars sealed with pine resin turn to wine that keeps past the vintage.
resin_sealed_wine.social_consequence: Wine is poured at feasts and offered to the dead; whoever holds the jars hosts the gatherings.

pressed_cheese.name: Pressed Cheese
pressed_cheese.observation: Curd pressed in pierced clay strainers sheds its whey and hardens into cheese that keeps the summer's milk for winter.
pressed_cheese.social_consequence: Cheese carries the herd's wealth into the cold months and can be traded far from the pasture.

managed_fallow.ability_reason: A rested field comes back stronger than one worked every year.

root_cellars.ability_reason: Cool, dark pits hold roots and fruit well past the season.

raised_granaries.ability_reason: Grain lifted on posts stays dry and beyond the reach of rats.

cutting_propagation.name: Planting from Cuttings
cutting_propagation.observation: A fig branch, an olive twig or a vine cane pushed into moist ground takes root and fruits true to its parent.
cutting_propagation.social_consequence: Orchards and vineyards take years to bear; the families that plant them stay put to harvest.

flour_sifting.ability_reason: Sifted flour carries less grit, so bread wears the teeth less.

offshoot_date_planting.name: Date Palm Offshoots
offshoot_date_planting.observation: Suckers cut from the foot of a good date palm grow into trees that bear the same sweet fruit.

fermentation_control.ability_reason: Fermented food and drink keep longer and sicken fewer people than fouled water.
fermentation_control.social_consequence: Brewing and fermenting become household skills handed down with their own vessels and customs.

irrigation_schedules.ability_reason: Water turned onto each field in its turn lets dry land bear grain every year.

ox_drawn_ard.name: Ox-Drawn Ard
ox_drawn_ard.observation: A yoked pair of oxen drags a pointed ard through ground that took a whole family days to hoe.
ox_drawn_ard.social_consequence: Households with a team plow far more land than those without; oxen become the measure of a family's standing.

salting_fish_meat.name: Salting Fish and Meat
salting_fish_meat.observation: Fish and meat packed in salt dry hard and keep through the lean months and on long journeys.
salting_fish_meat.social_consequence: Salt becomes worth trading for; the people who hold salt springs gain friends and rivals.

butter_churning.name: Butter Churning
butter_churning.observation: Milk rocked in a skin bag or clay churn gathers into butter, rich food that keeps longer than the milk.

winter_fodder.name: Winter Fodder
winter_fodder.observation: Leaves and grass cut and stacked in summer carry the herd through winter, so fewer beasts are slaughtered at the first frost.
winter_fodder.social_consequence: Haymaking fills the late summer; the whole household cuts, turns and stacks before the rains.

clay_dome_ovens.name: Clay Dome Ovens
clay_dome_ovens.observation: A domed clay oven holds its heat, and loaf after loaf bakes on one firing.
clay_dome_ovens.social_consequence: The oven becomes a meeting place where neighbours bake in turn and share news.

barley_beer.name: Barley Beer
barley_beer.observation: Malt and half-baked bread soaked and left to work become a thick, sour beer that people drink more safely than standing water.
barley_beer.social_consequence: Beer is food, wage and offering at once; work parties and feasts are measured in jars.

dried_fruit_cakes.name: Dried-Fruit Cakes
dried_fruit_cakes.observation: Figs, dates and raisins pressed into cakes and dried keep sweet for a year and travel in a satchel.

kitchen_gardens.name: Kitchen Gardens
kitchen_gardens.observation: Onion, garlic, leek and lettuce grown by the door and watered by hand fill the pot between harvests.
kitchen_gardens.social_consequence: Every household tends its own plot; gardens become the pride of the women who keep them.

grain_parboiling.ability_reason: Grain boiled then dried keeps better and cooks faster.

stock_rotation.ability_reason: Oldest stores used first means little is left to rot at the back.

brine_fermentation.ability_reason: Vegetables and fish in brine keep for months and sharpen a plain diet.

spoilage_inspection.name: Spoilage Inspection
spoilage_inspection.observation: Store keepers open, smell and tap every jar in turn and cull the spoiled before it taints the rest.
spoilage_inspection.social_consequence: Store keepers answer for losses; a clean store is a mark of a trustworthy steward.

regional_granaries.ability_reason: Grain gathered from many villages evens out a bad harvest in one valley.
regional_granaries.social_consequence: Whoever controls the granary controls the lean year; granary keepers become officials.

ghee.name: Ghee
ghee.observation: Butter simmered until clear and poured off its solids keeps for months even in the heat.

named_beers.name: Named Beers
named_beers.observation: Brewers name their beers by grain and strength, and a jar of 'strong dark' means the same in every house.

marked_wine_jars.name: Marked Wine Jars
marked_wine_jars.observation: Sealed jars stamped with the estate and the year of the vintage can be stored, counted and sent as tribute.

fattened_geese_ducks.name: Fattened Geese and Ducks
fattened_geese_ducks.observation: Geese and ducks penned by the water and fed on grain grow fat for the table and lay through the season.

work_gang_bakeries.name: Work-Gang Bakeries
work_gang_bakeries.observation: Great ovens and brewing vats beside the works turn out bread and beer by the hundred for the gangs.
work_gang_bakeries.social_consequence: Labor is paid in bread and beer; those who run the bakeries hold the gangs' loyalty.

stocked_fish_ponds.name: Stocked Fish Ponds
stocked_fish_ponds.observation: Young fish netted from the river and set in dug ponds grow there until the table needs them.
stocked_fish_ponds.social_consequence: Fish ponds belong to estates and temples; fish becomes a steady ration rather than a season's luck.

hive_beekeeping.name: Hive Beekeeping
hive_beekeeping.observation: Bees housed in stacked clay pipes and reed hives give honey and wax every year without felling a tree.
hive_beekeeping.social_consequence: Honey becomes a measured good for medicine, offering and trade; beekeepers become a trade of their own.

sesame_oil.name: Sesame for Oil
sesame_oil.observation: Sesame sown in the hot season is threshed and pressed for an oil that cooks, lights lamps and anoints the skin.

stall_fattened_cattle.name: Stall-Fattened Cattle
stall_fattened_cattle.observation: Oxen kept in stalls and fed on grain and fodder grow heavy for the great feasts.
stall_fattened_cattle.social_consequence: Feast cattle show a house's wealth; a great slaughter binds guests with a debt of hospitality.

jarred_salt_fish.name: Jarred Salt Fish
jarred_salt_fish.observation: Salted fish packed in sealed jars travels upriver and inland and is traded for grain and cloth.

fodder_barley.name: Fodder Barley
fodder_barley.observation: A barley field sown only for the oxen and asses keeps the draught teams strong through the heavy season.

graded_rations.name: Graded Rations
graded_rations.observation: Ration lists give men, women, children and nursing mothers each a set measure of grain and oil by their work and need.
graded_rations.social_consequence: Everyone knows their measure; complaints turn from hunger to whether the measure is just.

beam_olive_press.name: Beam Olive Press
beam_olive_press.observation: A long beam weighted with stones squeezes baskets of crushed olives, and oil runs in quantities no hand press could give.
beam_olive_press.social_consequence: The press owner takes a share of every family's oil; the pressing season becomes a village event.

flavouring_herbs.name: Flavouring Herbs
flavouring_herbs.observation: Coriander, cumin and mustard grown in garden rows flavour plain porridge and help preserve pickles.

named_breads.name: Named Breads
named_breads.observation: Bakers make dozens of named loaves, from plain ration bread to festival rings sweetened with dates and honey.

vinegar_pickling.ability_reason: Vinegar keeps vegetables, fish and fruit edible for a year.

date_palm_pollination.name: Hand-Pollinated Date Palms
date_palm_pollination.observation: Climbers carry flowering strands from the male palm to the female trees, and the groves bear far more fruit.

date_syrup_preserves.name: Date Syrup and Honey Preserves
date_syrup_preserves.observation: Fruit boiled down with date syrup or honey and sealed in jars stays sweet and sound through the year.

famine_reserves.name: Famine Reserves
famine_reserves.observation: Enough grain is sealed away to carry the land through two failed harvests, and it is opened only by order.
famine_reserves.social_consequence: A ruler who opens the stores in a famine is remembered; one who hoards them is cursed.

dried_salted_cheese.name: Dried Salted Cheese
dried_salted_cheese.observation: Cheese salted and dried hard on reed mats keeps for months on campaign and on the road.

separate_grain_lines.name: Separate Grain Lines
separate_grain_lines.observation: Bread wheat and brewing barley are sown, threshed and stored apart, each kept true from its own seed.

fruit_tree_grafting.name: Fruit Tree Grafting
fruit_tree_grafting.observation: A shoot from a good tree bound into the cut stock of a wild one bears the good tree's fruit within a few years.
fruit_tree_grafting.social_consequence: Grafters guard their knowledge; named fruit trees become heirlooms passed with the land.
